0022600125.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-0, 1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East) visit the Houston Rockets (2-0, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West), who are 1-0 at home. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Houston is without Fred VanVleet (knee), Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (ankle). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Hawks lost both meetings, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026.
